title: antennaria dioica var. corymbosa
intro: Antennaria dioica var. corymbosa, commonly known as Mountain Everlasting, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. This perennial herb is known for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Everlasting are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress and anxiety, and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, such as isovernicine, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
